acquisition_method: A data dependent mass spectrometric method was employed
alkylation_concentration: After reduction (5 mM DTT, 30 min) and alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark)
alkylation_reagent: After reduction (5 mM DTT, 30 min) and alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark)
cleavage_agent: proteins were digested for 3 h by Lys-C (Wako) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 100:1. Samples were diluted with 10 mM ammonium bicarbonate to 2 M urea prior to overnight trypsin digestion (Sequencing grade, Promega)
collision_energy: isolated (3 Th isolation width) and fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy 25)
fractionation_method: Peptides (180 μg) were separated by in-solution isoelectric focusing (OFFGEL fractionator, Agilent) into 12 fractions
fragmentation_method: fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
instrument: analyzed by liquid chromatography (LC) using an EASY nLC-II coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany)
mass_analyzer: inferred: Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany)
ptm: N-terminal acetylation, methionine oxidation, cysteine carbamidomethylation
N-terminal acetylation and methionine oxidation as variable modifications and cysteine carbamidomethylation as fixed modification
reduction_concentration: After reduction (5 mM DTT, 30 min) and alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark)
reduction_reagent: After reduction (5 mM DTT, 30 min) and alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark)
